items.title: 6 months to live for open models
takeaways: This excerpt only says open source AI is facing a major test, but gives no details on what changed or why it matters.
Do not switch strategies yet. Wait for follow up coverage that explains specifics before deciding whether to rely on open models for your product.
Keep an eye on this topic since shifts in open model viability could affect cost and vendor choices later, but it is too early to act on.
